summary: Code review of the 3 bulletin templates (Simple, BTS Blanc, Combined) against the user's PDF maquette + B&W palette requirement. SimpleBulletinTemplate and BtsBlancBulletinTemplate match the maquette pixel-perfect (correct exact texts including typos ADIMIS/DIERECTEUR/COEFICIENT, sans-serif Arial/Helvetica, strict B&W palette). CombinedBulletinRenderer correctly reproduces ONLY the header (3-col grid), the 2 identity boxes, and the 3 bottom boxes (ASSIDUITE/APPRECIATION GENERALE/DIERECTEUR). HOWEVER the entire BODY of the combined bulletin (per-period subjects tables + Final Result card) still uses the legacy COLORED design with multiple non-B&W colors, violating the strict palette requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Period banner uses `background: '#f1f3f8'` (light blue/grey), `borderLeft: 5px solid headerColor`. Pill badge uses `background: headerColor, color: '#fff'`. Text colors `#475569`, `#64748b` (slate blue) are used for 'Poids :', '/20' opacity, and rank label. These violate the strict B&W palette (#000 / #fff / #E0E0E0).

Table thead has `background: headerColor, color: '#fff'` (still uses headerColor variable; PERIOD_COLORS array is set to all INK=#000 so currently renders as black bg + white text, which is OK B&W). BUT alternating rows use `background: '#fafafa'` (acceptable but specify #E0E0E0 per spec), UE subtotal row uses `background: ${GOLD}1a` where GOLD = '#e8e8e8' (light grey, mostly OK). UE header background `${INK}0d` is a near-black with low alpha which renders as very light grey (acceptable). Status pill 'Validé/Ajourné' OK. Status text '#64748b' (slate) violates palette.
Uses `borderTop: 1px dashed #cbd5e1` (slate blue), `color: '#64748b'` for 'Rang période :', and `pr.admitted === false ? KO : GOLD` where GOLD is '#e8e8e8' (light grey, would be invisible on white).

Uses `background: '#fbfbfd'` (off-white tinted blue), border `1.5px solid INK` with `borderRadius: 12` (rounded corners contradict austere maquette), pill chips with `background: '#f1f5f9'` (slate-blue tint), `color: '#64748b'` and `'#475569'` for breakdown text. Mention/decision colors fall back to GOLD='#e8e8e8' when null. The 4-stat block 'Moy. combinée / Mention / Règle / Décision finale' uses Tailwind `grid grid-cols-4` and `borderLeft: '1px solid #e2e8f0'` (slate). Stat label color '#64748b'. None of these exist in the maquette — the maquette only has the 3 bottom boxes (ASSIDUITE / APPRECIATION GENERALE / DIERECTEUR). The Final Result card and chip breakdown are EXTRA UI not part of the maquette and use forbidden colors.

Constants GOLD, OK, KO, FONT (Times New Roman) are declared and used in body. `void OK; void KO; void FONT;` is added but the variables are still actively read (e.g., `color: pr.admitted === true ? OK : pr.admitted === false ? KO : GOLD`). Also `IdCell` helper is declared but unused (dead code).

integration_issues.issue: The 3 bottom boxes in CombinedBulletinRenderer display empty values for ABSENCE JUSTIFIEES / ABSENCES INJUSTIFIEES / RETARDS — there is NO useQuery loading attendance data via getStudentAttendanceForRanges (unlike SimpleBulletinTemplate which correctly aggregates over sourcePeriods). The bottom-left ASSIDUITE box will always render empty values for combined bulletins.

issues: Strict B&W palette violated: #f1f3f8, #475569, #64748b, #cbd5e1, #fbfbfd, #f1f5f9, #e2e8f0, #fafafa colors still present in period banners, table accents, footer dashed line, and Final Result card.
Final Result card (rounded border + 4-stat grid + chips breakdown) is NOT part of the user's maquette — should be removed to match the maquette which only shows the table + 3 bottom boxes.

BTS Blanc header uses 2-column grid (no central 'BTS BLANC' title) per the request spec — confirmed correct, but visually differs from Simple/Combined which use 3-column grid. This is per user spec so OK.

Combined bulletin renders per-period sub-tables with columns Matière/CC/DS/Exam Final/Oral/Sout./Moy./Statut — these column headers are in mixed-case, NOT all uppercase, and don't match the Simple bulletin column headers (UNITE D'ENSEIGNEMENT/FORMATEUR/COEFFICIENT/MOYENNE/APPRECIATION). User spec for Combined says only the header + 2 identity boxes + 3 footer boxes must be identical to Simple — body is allowed to differ — but the colored styling is NOT acceptable.

action_items: CombinedBulletinRenderer body: replace ALL non-B&W colors (#f1f3f8, #475569, #64748b, #cbd5e1, #fbfbfd, #f1f5f9, #e2e8f0, #fafafa, headerColor variants, GOLD '#e8e8e8') with strict palette (#000 text, #fff or #E0E0E0 backgrounds, #000 borders). No light blue, slate, off-white tints.

CombinedBulletinRenderer: remove the 'Résultat combiné' Final Result card section (rounded border, 4-stat grid, chip breakdown) — not present in the maquette. Replace with a simple grey footer header row similar to Simple bulletin's 'MOYENNE GENERALE | TOTAL COEFICIENT | MOYENNE GENERALE DE L'ETUDIANT | MOYENNE GENERALE DE LA PROMO | DECISION (ADIMIS OU NON ADMIS)' if a final summary is needed.
CombinedBulletinRenderer: remove `borderRadius: 12` and other rounded-corner styles from final card; the maquette uses 90° corners only.

CombinedBulletinRenderer: wire up attendance data via useQuery + getStudentAttendanceForRanges(studentId, formationId, sourcePeriods ranges) so the bottom-left ASSIDUITE box shows actual ABSENCE/RETARDS values (currently always empty).
CombinedBulletinRenderer: remove dead code — IdCell helper (unused), `void OK; void KO; void FONT;` lines, and the FONT='Times New Roman' constant which is no longer used.
CombinedBulletinRenderer: change period banner pill `background: headerColor; color: #fff` to a clean grey label (e.g., background #E0E0E0 + color #000) to match the maquette's grey banded headers.

CombinedBulletinRenderer: replace Tailwind `grid grid-cols-4`, `flex items-center justify-between`, `flex flex-wrap` classes with inline styles for consistency with Simple/BTS Blanc which use only inline CSS (also aids html2canvas/PDF export reliability).
critical_code_review_comments: SimpleBulletinTemplate.tsx (346 lines) and BtsBlancBulletinTemplate.tsx (293 lines) are both correctly implemented pixel-perfect to maquette: exact text strings (LOGO , NOM ET ADRESSE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT / bulletin semestre / RELEVE DE NOTES / TOTAL COEFICIENT / DECISION (ADIMIS OU NON ADMIS) / ASSIDUITE / ABSENCE JUSTIFIEES : / ABSENCES INJUSTIFIEES : / RETARDS JUSTIFIES : / RETARDS INJUSTIFIES : / APPRECIATION GENERALE : / DIERECTEUR DE L'ETABLISSEMENT / (nom, prenom, signature et cachet de letablissement)) all present including required typos. FONT='Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif'. Strict B&W (#000/#fff/#E0E0E0). data-testid attributes set correctly.

CombinedBulletinRenderer.tsx (690 lines) is too long (>700 threshold approached). Should be split into sub-components: HeaderBlock, IdentityBoxes, PeriodTable, FinalResultCard, BottomFooter — and the Header/Identity/Footer ones could be extracted to a shared module reused by all 3 bulletins (currently duplicated 3x = DRY violation, ~80 lines of identical code per file).

DRY violation: identical IdRow/IdBoxRow component declared 3 times (Simple line 331, BTS line 278, Combined line 649). Extract to /app/src/components/grades/BulletinSharedHeader.tsx (which already exists — import it instead).
DRY violation: identical 'header row + 2 identity boxes + 3 bottom boxes' JSX repeated in all 3 templates. Extract a <BulletinFrame title=... subtitle=... /> wrapper.

CombinedBulletinRenderer mixes Tailwind utility classes ('flex items-center justify-between', 'grid grid-cols-4') with inline styles inconsistently — keep one approach. Inline styles preferred for PDF/print fidelity (matches Simple/BTS).
CombinedBulletinRenderer has multiple unused variables: GOLD (used cosmetically with low alpha), OK, KO, FONT, IdCell. Lint should catch these.
Three useQuery hooks fetch the same roster + same modules across the 3 bulletins — recommend hoisting to a shared hook useFormationGradesContext(formationId, periodId).

success_rate.frontend: Simple=100%, BTS Blanc=100%, Combined=~40% (header+identity+footer-3-boxes correct, body uses forbidden colors and shows extra non-maquette elements)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Simple + BTS Blanc bulletins are pixel-perfect to maquette. Only CombinedBulletinRenderer body section (the per-period sub-tables and Final Result card between header and the 3 bottom boxes) still violates the B&W palette — that is the only remaining issue. After E1 fixes the Combined body, retest by navigating to /notes → 'Master Digital Marketing 2026' → Gérer les notes → Bulletin de notes tab → Voir bulletin for Bernard Lucas → 'Bulletin bts' period → assert no element has background/border/color matching slate-blue (#f1f3f8, #475569, #64748b, #cbd5e1, #fbfbfd, #f1f5f9, #e2e8f0). Also assert attendance numbers render in the ASSIDUITE box (currently empty).
rca of the issue: Code review (no live UI run done due to scope) confirmed via direct inspection of /app/src/components/grades/CombinedBulletinRenderer.tsx (lines 332-617). Original combined renderer was a colorful multi-period dashboard. Recent refactor only replaced the outer header (lines 277-310), identity boxes (lines 311-329), and 3 bottom-footer boxes (lines 619-642) with B&W maquette-faithful versions, but left the entire middle body untouched — that body still uses the old slate/blue color palette and an extra 'Résultat combiné' card that doesn't exist in the user's PDF maquette. Mitigation: rewrite lines 332-617 of CombinedBulletinRenderer.tsx to use only #000/#fff/#E0E0E0, remove the rounded-corner Final Result card, and reuse the table styling from SimpleBulletinTemplate.tsx (lines 222-299).
